infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RM ONE uses the camera to attach photos to project records and inbox messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RM ONE accesses your photo library so you can attach images to project records and inbox messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RM ONE saves project attachments to your photo library when you choose to download them.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RM ONE uses the microphone when you record voice notes for project updates.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RM ONE uses your location to show nearby project sites and tag records with the current city.
infoPlist.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: RM ONE accesses your Documents folder so you can attach files to project records.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: RM ONE uses Face ID to keep your account secure.
